final_message:
Configured the 31 requested authoritative zones on pc1–pc31 and the recursive resolver on pc32 (`10.15.8.14`). Clients pc33–pc40 now use that resolver.

Created the BIND configuration and zone files, appended DNS startup commands, and changed pc1–pc32 to the `kathara/bind` image in [lab.conf](/private/var/folders/84/zz92dr1178v8z_tvd_q2dfw40000gn/T/kathara-aut-jw5skrla/lab/lab.conf). The existing topology, addresses, and routes were preserved.

No web service was identified in the lab, so `www.example.com` points to pc33 (`10.15.9.11`) as an assumption; a web service still needs to run there. BIND validation tools were unavailable locally, and runtime DNS checks remain to be performed externally.
